cells.gaps: Nothing admissible shows a per-learner system live in primary schools: the 2018 OpenEMIS pilot gives neither the schools' level nor who entered the records, and nothing dated since says whether it still runs. LEMIS, the ministry's DHIS2 for Education system, is reported for all 365 secondary schools in October 2026 (LSO-007), with training on teacher records, class management and attendance, but no source says primary schools use it or that learners' attendance is entered per learner. No plan or finance is stated; LSO-001 to LSO-003 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: Stage 2: a 2018 per-learner pilot, and in 2026 a ministry system reported in secondary schools only. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in primary schools, and no admissible row shows one.
